background: SEB is a Swedish universal bank with a corporate and institutional focus, funded by Swedish and Baltic deposits and covered bonds and lending to large Nordic corporates, Swedish households and businesses in the Baltic states.
synthesis: Rated AA on average across all three, the weakest of them at AA-, all on a stable outlook after a two-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026. Capital is sound, with CET1 of 17.2% above the peer median though leverage of 5.1% is below it. Liquidity is the weak spot against EU and Nordic banks, with LCR of 125% and NSFR of 110% both in the bottom quarter. None of the ratios has moved materially over the past four periods to 30 Sep 2026.
